description_en: Modifies the consumption checkpoint of a change tracking instance channel
description_zh: 修改数据订阅实例通道的消费时间点
kebab_example: aliyun dts modify-consumption-timestamp --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subscription-instance-id dtsg2m10r1x15a0000 --consumption-timestamp 2019-10-15T17:20:03Z --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyConsumptionTimestamp

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the DescribeSubscriptionInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeSubscriptionInstances接口查询
parameters.name: subscription_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The consumption checkpoint in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
parameters.name: consumption_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
